ValidationRule.description: Once a Personal Client is flagged High-Profile, only users with the Sahra Privacy Override permission set can downgrade it back to Standard. Prevents accidental loss of privacy posture.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Private Client", ISCHANGED(Data_Sensitivity_Flag__c), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Data_Sensitivity_Flag__c), "High-Profile"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Sensitivity_Flag__c, "Standard"), NOT($Permission.Sahra_Privacy_Override) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the System Administrator or Head of Social Events can downgrade a High-Profile client to Standard. If this change is intentional, please contact them. This safeguard protects client confidentiality.
